# buddy_domains (Data Source)

List domains and optionally filter them by type or name

Token scope required: `DOMAIN_READ`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "buddy_domains" "all" {
  workspace_domain = "myworkspace"
}

data "buddy_domains" "private" {
  workspace_domain = "myworkspace"
  type             = "PRIVATE"
}

data "buddy_domains" "filter" {
  workspace_domain = "myworkspace"
  domain_regex     = "\\.com$"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_domain` (String) The workspace's URL handle

### Optional

- `domain_regex` (String) The domain's name regular expression to match
- `type` (String) List only domains of the given type. Allowed values: POINTED, PRIVATE, REGISTERED, CLAIMED

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes Set) List of domains (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `id` (String) The Terraform resource identifier for this item

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)
- `html_url` (String)
